name: Animx
original_description: Animx creates images and videos from a text prompt. Describe the scene you want and Animx generates it: text-to-image, text-to-video, and turning a still image into a short video. You can also check the status of a generation while it renders, and open or download the finished image or video. Animx is for people who have an Animx account: sign in through ChatGPT, and the plugin only reads and creates the generations that belong to that account.
